description:
# Proposed Standard OAuth coverage implementation plan

## Scope and findings

Planning only; no implementation or validation has run. Target:
`lib/zaq/engine/connect/oauth/behaviours/standard.ex`, supplied coverage 87%, missed line 30.
Serena confirms line 30 (one-based) is `runtime_identity(_metadata), do: %{}`,
the non-map fallback. Lines 22–28 handle maps. The supplied percentage has not
been independently remeasured.

Read AGENTS.md, tool routing, testing handbook, workflow, and applicable Engine
OAuth and system-configuration contracts. Context Mode failed with a disk I/O
error; source inspection used Serena and bounded direct reads. `bw prime` was
read-only; a follow-up filtered list command rejected its unsupported `--search`
flag. No task-specific ownership assignment was established.

## Exact implementation surface and ownership

Edit only `test/zaq/engine/connect/oauth_behaviour_test.exs`, module
`Zaq.Engine.Connect.OAuthBehaviourTest`. Append Standard-specific cases alongside
the current Codex identity test and shared OAuth metadata property.

**Shared OAuth test ownership:** this file covers both Standard and Codex.
Coordinate the edit with any concurrent OAuth/Codex coverage owner; use additive
changes and preserve the existing assertions/property. The observed dirty files
are `test/e2e/specs/system_config.spec.js`, `test/e2e/support/bo.js`,
`test/e2e/support/people-auth-browser.cjs`, and
`test/zaq_web/people_browser_test.exs`; preserve those existing changes.

## Cases, inputs and assertions

1. Add test named `Standard exports no runtime identity for non-map metadata`.
   Invoke the real `Standard.runtime_identity/1` directly for each of:
   `nil`, `false`, `true`, `:invalid`, `0`, `-1`, `1.5`, `""`,
   `"account_id"`, `<<255>>`, `[]`, `[account_id: "acct_untrusted"]`,
   `[{"account_id", "acct_untrusted"}]`, and
   `{"account_id", "acct_untrusted"}`.
   Assert exact equality with `%{}` for every input, with the input identified in
   the assertion diagnostic. Every case maps to line 30. The pair lists and tuple
   specifically prove that map-like malformed data cannot export identity.

2. Add property named `Standard rejects every non-map runtime identity input`.
   Reuse the existing ExUnitProperties imports: generate `metadata <- term()`,
   constrain with `not is_map(metadata)`, and set `max_runs: 100`.
   Assert `Standard.runtime_identity(metadata) == %{}` on each generated input.
   This exercises line 30 over a broad input space and protects the fail-closed
   identity projection invariant. Explicit examples above guarantee the important
   categories independently of generator sampling.

Existing tests already verify positive Standard map projection of `account_id`
and `account_name`, rejection of Codex-only identity, and unrelated-key exclusion.
Retain them as the map-path control; do not duplicate them in the new fallback tests.

## Reuse, isolation and reachability

Reuse `use ExUnit.Case, async: true`, `use ExUnitProperties`, and the existing
`Standard` alias. No new helpers, mocks, fixtures, configuration modules or support
files are necessary. Existing `test/support/oauth_bridge_stubs.ex` stubs token
refresh, which is unrelated to this pure function; do not use it.

Calls are synchronous and pure: no database/Sandbox, HTTP, encryption, credentials,
application-environment mutations, processes, timers, sleeps or polling. Keep
`async: true`; an `async: false` module is unnecessary.

The fallback is directly reachable through Standard's public function. It is
defensive behavior outside the callback's declared map input type: the normal
`OAuth.runtime_identity/2` facade has an `is_map(metadata)` guard, and the resolver
passes `grant.metadata || %{}`. Therefore an integration test through that facade
cannot exercise line 30. Do not corrupt database metadata or weaken the guard to
reach it. No unreachable-code exclusion or production test hook is justified.

Action reuse assessment: **N/A — test-only**, with no executable operation changes.
E2E/integration coverage is unnecessary for this pure defensive projection.

## Ordered validation commands for the implementer

Run from the repository root only after implementation is authorized. Use Context
Mode once its disk I/O issue is resolved; report a blocker if still unavailable.

1. `mix q` — required issue quality check, including formatting. Because the tree
   contains other work, coordinate before running this formatter and verify it
   has not introduced changes to another owner's files.
2. `mix test test/zaq/engine/connect/oauth_behaviour_test.exs --seed 812387`
3. `mix coveralls.json test/zaq/engine/connect/oauth_behaviour_test.exs --seed 812387 --output-dir cover/standard-oauth-fallback`
   — allow 600,000 ms. Inspect that report's exact Standard source entry and verify
   the one-based line-30 counter is positive. Focused coverage may omit other
   Standard callbacks; do not compare its whole-module percentage directly with
   the supplied aggregate 87%.
4. At the final coverage gate, `mix coveralls.json` (600,000 ms), followed only on
   success by `mix coverup`. Verify line 30 is covered and whole-file coverage is
   at least 95%; if the supplied report's only gap was line 30 and all other
   coverage remains, expect 100%. Record fresh counts rather than assuming this.
5. At final implementation handoff, `mix precommit` (900,000 ms), after all required
   changes/checks. No redundant full test run is needed.

Acceptance: both new cases pass, original shared OAuth tests still pass, a fresh
report records line 30 executed, and no production/support changes or unrelated
dirty-tree modifications are introduced. Diagnose failures without weakening
assertions; never substitute stale coverage after a failed or timed-out run.


Coordinator execution override: tests only in assigned files, preserve pre-existing edits; no worker Mix/Git/Beadwork mutations. Coordinator alone runs mix q and added/edited tests --cover. No full-suite or precommit execution for this coverage task.

No production edits, commits, or full-suite runs. Temporary display configuration restored. Keep remaining gaps/plan exceptions visible; no claim every line covered.
